title: Right to protest: Many detained as demand grows to scrap Freedom Park restriction in Bengaluru

ai.summary: Over 200 protesters were detained by Bengaluru City Police as they attempted to march towards Vidhana Soudha, demanding the Karnataka government withdraw a 2021 order restricting protests to Freedom Park. Civil society groups, including trade unions and slum residents, argue the restriction prevents people from addressing local issues directly with authorities.
